nodes.label: Natural Language Autoencoders (NLAs)
nodes.author: Kantamneni, kitft, Ong, Marks (Anthropic)
nodes.rationale: Unsupervised method for generating natural language explanations of LLM activations; jointly trains activation verbalizer (AV) and activation reconstructor (AR) with RL to reconstruct residual stream activations.

nodes.label: Activation Verbalizer (AV)
nodes.rationale: Maps target model activation to text description; trained to produce explanations that enable accurate reconstruction; initialized with warm-start data from Claude's summaries of target model behavior.

nodes.label: Activation Reconstructor (AR)
nodes.rationale: Maps text explanation back to activation; jointly trained with AV; reconstruction fidelity (cosine similarity, FVE) serves as training signal; good explanations enable accurate reconstruction.

nodes.label: Unverbalized Evaluation Awareness Discovery
nodes.rationale: NLAs revealed Claude suspects safety testing even when not verbalized; 16% evaluation awareness on destructive code task, 26% on SWE-bench, <1% on real claude.ai usage; indicates model thinks but doesn't say.

nodes.label: Auditing Game for Hidden Motivations
nodes.rationale: NLA-equipped auditors uncovered misaligned motivation 12-15% of time without training data; baseline <3%; demonstrates NLAs can surface hidden goals directly from model thoughts.

nodes.label: NLA Limitations: Hallucination, Cost, Steganography
nodes.rationale: NLAs hallucinate details not in context; expensive (RL on 2 model copies, hundreds of tokens per activation); risk of steganography (explanations compress activations in non-semantic ways); mitigated via paraphrasing tests.
